spec.title: Proposed ingestion: Owner or tier-0 commissioning, Lead ownership and independent Oracle review

problem.symptom: Historical ingestion left orchestration and unresolved acceptance handoffs with tier 0.
why: Approval, processing start, per-item enrichment and later acceptance were compressed into one apparent operation.
Semantic decisions were assigned to scripts, and Oracle review was confused with coordinating repairs.
problem.root: The parent needs accountable role ownership, explicit authority and truthful child outcomes, composed through existing registered processes.
